hero.title: Plan your day one question at a time
hero.line: For mornings when your head is full and the list has no order yet.

steps.energy: Say how much energy you have. One word is enough.
steps.yesterday: See what came along from yesterday, with no verdict attached.
steps.thoughts: Put the loose thoughts somewhere they can wait.
steps.questions: Answer one question per task until the anchor is clear: "What breaks if this waits until tomorrow?"

low.title: On a low day
low.body: Low mode keeps one task on the screen, plus the first ten-minute step. Everything else ebbs away until you are ready.

notHere.title: What you won't find here
notHere.body: No chains of good days, no points, no red marks for what moved, no counter on the app icon. A low day is information, not a debt.

together.title: Together, if you want
together.body: Shared spaces for a household, a family or a small team. You see who takes what on, and nobody gets nudged.

price.title: Price
price.body: 7 days free. Then 30 € a year at founder pricing, locked for as long as you stay. Each extra member is 5 € a year.
price.selfHost: You can also run ebbe yourself, and you can export your data at any time.

app.question: Is there an app?
app.answer: Yes. ebbe is an installable PWA that sits on your homescreen like any other app.

data.question: Where does my data live?
data.answer: On the server that runs your account. When you host ebbe yourself, it stays on your own machine.

export.question: Can I export and delete my data?
export.answer: Yes. Export gives you a file with everything, and delete removes the account and its data.

trial.question: What happens after the trial?
trial.answer: Your days stay readable and you can still export everything. A subscription brings planning back.

adhd.question: Is this made for ADHD?
adhd.answer: It is made for full heads and mornings that feel like too much. It is not a medical product and makes no medical promise.
